rule: 流式逐行扫描语料：先定位 Methods 节标题行进窗、遇 Discussion 节标题行出窗，窗内整行以 Step N: 起首者判为步骤标题（按位置取、编号序列校验 1..N 连续）；禁用标题去重、禁按标题内容判步骤

steps.label: S1
steps.title: Step 1: Development of the scope and definition of the ontology
steps.input: 语料 Introduction 节与 Good practice in ontology development 节（L11–L12）的既有内容
steps.output: ontology 的 scope 与 definition（Step 1 标题：Development of the scope and definition of the ontology）

steps.label: S2
steps.title: Step 2: Identifying key entities and developing their preliminary definitions
steps.input: Step 1 产出的 scope and definition
steps.output: key entities 及其 preliminary definitions（Step 2 标题：Identifying key entities and developing their preliminary definitions）

steps.label: S3
steps.title: Step 3: Refining the ontology through an iterative process of literature annotation, discussion and revision
steps.input: Step 2 产出的 key entities 与 preliminary definitions
steps.output: 经文献标注、讨论与修订迭代精炼的 ontology（Step 3 标题：Refining the ontology through an iterative process of literature annotation, discussion and revision）

steps.label: S4
steps.title: Step 4: Expert stakeholder review
steps.output: 专家利益相关者的评审意见（Step 4 标题：Expert stakeholder review）

steps.label: S5
steps.title: Step 5: Testing inter-rater reliability and making revisions
steps.output: inter-rater reliability 的测定结果与据此所作的修订（Step 5 标题：Testing inter-rater reliability and making revisions）

steps.label: S6
steps.title: Step 6: Specifying relationships between entities in the ontology
steps.input: Step 5 修订后的 ontology 实体集
steps.output: 实体间关系的精确说明（Step 6 标题：Specifying relationships between entities in the ontology）

steps.label: S7
steps.title: Step 7: Disseminating and maintaining the ontology
steps.input: Step 6 完成关系说明的 ontology
steps.output: ontology 的发布与维护安排（Step 7 标题：Disseminating and maintaining the ontology）
